meta.title: eRFX Auction stage with Duration 30 Mins
gaps: Assert that Bidding Ends At is exactly 30 minutes after the auction start time.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert that Bidding Ends At is exactly 30 minutes after the auction start time.

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen, which starts with the Auction stage.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Choose the first available auction template.
Add the required single auction item.
Complete the auction pricing sheet for the item.
Verify the schedule summary reflects the requested 30-minute duration.
Invite two QA vendors as required by the scenario.
Publish the configured eRFX auction event.
Verify publication reached a real project page.
Verify the published Project Details view exposes the bidding end-time subject.
